SELECT A.TASK_ID as taskId, A.SEQ_NO, B.TASK_NAME as taskName, D.BATCH_SEQ_NO as taskGroupId, C.BATCH_NAME as taskGroupName, D.PRD_GROUP_SEQ_NO as prdGroupId, E.GROUP_NAME as prdGroupName, D.START_DATE as businessStartDate, D.END_DATE as businessEndDate, A.EXECUTE_DATE as batchDate, A.CREATE_TIME batchStartTime, CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS in ('EXP', 'END') THEN A.UPDATE_TIME ELSE null END as batchEndTime, CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS in ('EXP', 'END') THEN round(extract(second from (A.UPDATE_TIME - a.CREATE_TIME)),2) else 0 END useingTime, A.TASK_STATUS as taskStatus, A.TASK_STATUS as taskStatusCode, A.START_MODE as startMode, #{detailName} detailName, A.CREATE_USER as createUser FROM SYS_BATCH_EXEC_INFO A, SYS_BATCH_TASK B, SYS_BATCH_GRP C, SYS_BATCHGRP_EXEC_INFO D LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_PRD_GRP E ON D.PRD_GROUP_SEQ_NO = E.SEQ_NO WHERE A.TASK_ID = B.TASK_ID AND A.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO = D.SEQ_NO AND D.BATCH_SEQ_NO = C.SEQ_NO
